title: Keep going while…
concept: Repeat a block while a condition is True, so one program fits any size

steps.say: The robot must walk to the end of the corridor.
Run it. This corridor needs 7 moves, so the robot stops short.
`while` checks. It repeats `move()` as long as `front_is_clear()` is True.
The condition is checked before every pass. Where will the robot stop?
Run it. At the wall, `front_is_clear()` is False, so the loop ends.
Same code in a 1-cell corridor: the condition is False at once, so `move()` never runs.
A condition can be about gems too. `while gems_here():` picks until the cell is empty.
After `move()`, look at the cell: add `if gems_here():` with `pick()` inside the loop.
A pile needs more than one `pick()`. Change `if` to `while`.

guided.done: Every pile cleared, in corridors of any length.

recap.say: `while condition:` repeats its block until the condition is False.

piles: Look at the result for the world with a pile on the start cell.
`if` picks one gem; `while gems_here():` clears a pile. Clear the start cell before the walk.
follow_trail: Look where the robot must stop in the Goal view: just past the last gem, not at the wall.
Loop on the gems, not the wall: repeat while there is a gem here.
